desc: Ideation: select a compact O(nm) no-turn/one-turn DP as the primary approach instead of prefix/suffix.

Implement the compact O(nm) DP solution in the starter code using the specified directions, topological orders, `dp0` then `dp1`, length-parity expected values, and real-turn requirement `plen0 >= 2`.
Run the current solution on the four provided examples and report the sample tests verdict (PASSED/FAILED) with the actual outputs.
Validate edge cases: no 1, 1x1, straight-only, boundary turns, counterclockwise turn rejection, and 500x500 performance/memory.
